ATAX.algorithm: Nominal ATAX forms tmp=A*x then y=A^T*tmp. A is4096x4096 row-major FP32 (64MiB), x/y/tmp each4096 floats (16KiB). init_array sets x[i]=i*pi,A[i,j]=i*j/NX (S:42-54). Literal GPU semantics include unspecified tmp0/y0. CPU reference explicitly zeros both (S:113-136). Preserve this distinction from mathematically correct ATAX.

GPU allocates/copies four objects, launches atax_kernel1 then synchronize, atax_kernel2 then synchronize, DtoH y/free (S:139-176). Blocks(256,1), grids(16,1) for both;128 warps per phase. No host iteration. DtoH uses NX at S:170 although y length NY; equality4096 masks this generalized-dimension issue.

Kernel2 consumes kernel1 tmp. One thread owns one output; each reduction is a serial per-thread recurrence. No shared tile, barrier, texture, atomic or reduction tree.

Phase2: A=BA+4*(t*4096+q),tmp=Bt+4*t,y=By+4*q. Lane deltas4/0/4 B; loop deltas16384/4/0 B (S:86-107). Eight CTA warps cover256 rows in phase1/256 columns in phase2. Different CTAs own disjoint output and share the broadcast vector.
ATAX.locality: At fixed t a full phase1 warp touches32 distinct128B lines and32 sectors for128 unique useful bytes: cold transfer-unit amplification32x/8x. Consecutive t then uses each row line over32 positions/sector over8; poor lane coalescing coexists with loop spatial reuse. Phase2 aligned contiguous warp uses1 line/4 sectors; a thread strides16KiB. Uniform vector operand uses1 line/sector for4 unique bytes, revisited by warps/CTAs. Phase1 CTA source traversal spans4MiB A. Both phases revisit64MiB A, and tmp has a producer/consumer edge; retention is conditional. Only16 CTAs/128 warps exist per phase, so active-SM coverage<=min(16,SMcount), regardless of4096 loop length. Independent A/vector addresses coexist with recurrent accumulation; actual outstanding requests require compiled scheduling/runtime evidence.

GPU copies five objects (S:149-158), sets block256/grid16, launches kernel1 then kernel2 on default stream and synchronizes once (S:160-166), reads both outputs and frees (S:170-177). No separate streams or host loop. Algebraic independence does not mean simultaneous execution here.

Each thread owns one output with serial accumulation. No shared tile, device barrier, atomic, texture or parallel reduction.

Across CTAs read vectors are shared.

A repeats across kernels, but64MiB reuse does not prove cache persistence. Outputs have no producer/consumer edge. Only16 CTAs/128 warps per phase, active-SM coverage<=min(16,SMcount).
